newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products firm as holidays kill trade.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products firm as holidays kill trade.

text.p: NWE oil products were firm on Monday with the Pentacost holiday subdueing trade.
Gasoline was firm in line with crude's strength. Eurograde barges were done at $208, $209.5 and $209.50 a tonne fob ARA in early trade. Napththa was firm in line with crude but the market was quiet.
Gas oil was firmer as IPE futures leapt by nearly $5.00, but premiums were steady in limited discussion.
Fuel oil was very quiet, though June barge swaps at $86.50/$87.50 suggested some upside. Low sulphur was steady at higher numbers hit on Friday after a $95 fob cargo deal.
